additional_info.subject: RE: ID0436527-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R5 170001874] Cancels charging immediately after start CRM:02919000146
additional_info.body:
Dear Eduard Semiraut,
I hope you're doing well.
We have completed our analysis of the logs corresponding to the provided timestamp. Multiple transaction failures occurred with the same ID tag, and the root causes are summarized below:
Outlet Mismatch:
Authentication was completed on Outlet 1, but the EV was connected to Outlet 2. This mismatch caused the session initiation to fail.
Insulation Resistance Drop:
Some attempts failed due to a drop in the insulation resistance of the EVSE, which triggered a safety shutdown.
Authentication Error:
One of the attempts failed due to an authentication issue.
Following these failed attempts, a subsequent session was successfully initiated without further errors.
Please let us know if you need additional details or assistance regarding these events.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
